SELECT l."RNP" AS stored_rnp, TYPEOF(l."RNP") AS storage_type,
       COUNT(*) AS lab_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID") AS patients
FROM "Patient" AS p
JOIN "Laboratory" AS l ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE p."First Date" >= '1991-01-01' AND p."First Date" < '1992-01-01'
GROUP BY l."RNP", TYPEOF(l."RNP")
ORDER BY lab_rows DESC, stored_rnp

arguments.sql:
WITH recorded_rnp AS (
    SELECT p."ID", l."RNP"
    FROM "Patient" AS p
    JOIN "Laboratory" AS l ON l."ID" = p."ID"
    WHERE p."First Date" >= '1991-01-01'
      AND p."First Date" < '1992-01-01'
      AND l."RNP" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT "ID", "RNP"
FROM recorded_rnp
WHERE CAST("RNP" AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST("RNP" AS INTEGER))
    FROM recorded_rnp
)
ORDER BY "ID"
